faq.description: Learn how NextJob protects your career data, prevents AI fabrication, and keeps you in control.

whatDoesOurPlatformDo.question: What does NextJob do?
whatDoesOurPlatformDo.answer: NextJob maintains one verified career profile and reuses it across job discovery, eligibility & fit evaluation, evidence-constrained resume tailoring, and application tracking.

howWillThisBenefitMyBusiness.question: How does NextJob prevent AI hallucinations in resumes?
howWillThisBenefitMyBusiness.answer: Our tailoring engine only uses claims you have explicitly marked as Verified (with confidence >= 0.8) and preserves exact employer names, institutions, and dates.

isMyDataSafe.question: What happens when a job submission lacks confirmation?
isMyDataSafe.answer: NextJob never marks an application as Confirmed without confirmation evidence. Uncertain attempts enter 'Submission Uncertain' and block automatic retries.

whatKindOfIntegrationsAreAvailable.question: What import and export formats are supported?
whatKindOfIntegrationsAreAvailable.answer: You can import PDF, DOCX, plain text resumes, and JSON Resume files, and export tailored documents to DOCX, print-ready PDF/HTML, and JSON Resume.

howEasyIsItToOnboardMyTeam.question: How do conversational career updates work?
howEasyIsItToOnboardMyTeam.answer: Tell the AI assistant about a promotion or new skill. It creates a structured proposal in pending review—your authoritative profile only changes after you approve it.

whatTypesOfBusinessesCanUseThis.question: Does NextJob support Arabic and RTL layouts?
whatTypesOfBusinessesCanUseThis.answer: Yes. Both the web application and exported resume documents support English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL).

canICustomizeThisToFitMyBusinessNeeds.question: Is NextJob open-source and self-hostable?
canICustomizeThisToFitMyBusinessNeeds.answer: Yes. NextJob is built on an open-source modular monolith stack with Next.js, Hono, Better Auth, Drizzle, and PostgreSQL.
